title: Our girls stun HK to book World Junior Team C'ships final berth against Egypt
desc: PETALING JAYA: The Malaysian girls' squash team pulled off a stunning win to defeat Hong Kong and book their spot in the World Junior Team Championships final in Canada on Thursday (July 30).

title: New report highlights health of the UK's plankton communities
desc: Researchers from the University of Plymouth have led the production of a new report highlighting the impact of climate change on marine plankton and pelagic habitats in U.K. waters. Published by the Marine Climate Change Impacts Partnership (MCCIP), the report discusses the latest evidence showing major large-scale shifts already happening in plankton communities.

title: Meralco turns Sta. Rita extension into P4.2B in customer savings
desc: Manila Electric Co. (Meralco) said it has secured more than P4.2 billion in customer savings after renegotiating the latest extension of its power supply agreement with the First Gas Santa Rita plant.

title: 94 fake PF accounts, Rs 19.33 crore stolen: CBI case against Nokia officials
desc: The CBI has booked two Nokia Solutions and Networks India employees in an alleged ₹19.33 crore EPFO fraud involving 94 fake accounts. The case draws on EPFO's probe and Nokia's forensic audit, after which the company suspended both men and informed authorities.

title: MAP backs Pax Silica project but urges safeguards
desc: THE Management Association of the Philippines (MAP) said the country should pursue the US-led Pax Silica project in Clark but safeguards must be in place to uphold national interest.

title: U.S. and China discuss trade and rare earths in call ahead of Xi visit
desc: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said he held a call Thursday with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng to lay the groundwork for President Xi Jinping’s U.S. visit in September.
